blocks.zh: ISO 13926-3:2019 — Seals for Pen-Injectors for Medical Use / 筆型注射器用密封件
blocks.en: ISO 13926-3:2019 — Seals for Pen-Injectors for Medical Use

blocks.zh: Pen Systems: Seals (Needle Seals / Septums) — Part 3 | 筆型系統：密封件（針頭密封墊/隔膜）第三部分
blocks.en: Pen Systems: Seals (Needle Seals / Septums) — Part 3

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握筆型注射器密封件（seal/septum）的雙重功能：防止藥液洩漏 + 允許針頭穿刺後自動重新密封
blocks.en: Understand the dual function of a pen-injector seal (septum): preventing drug leakage and automatically resealing after needle penetration

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 13926-3 的分類（Type A 單層 / Type B 雙層）、尺寸規格與標稱指定方式
blocks.en: Understand the ISO 13926-3 classification (Type A single-layer / Type B double-layer), dimensional specifications and designation system

blocks.zh: 熟悉 seal 的物理要求：硬度、無碎屑（fragmentation）、無洩漏（leakage）、自密封性（resealability）、耐老化
blocks.en: Become familiar with the physical requirements for the seal: hardness, freedom from fragmentation, freedom from leakage, resealability and resistance to ageing

blocks.zh: 了解化學與生物要求：ISO 8871-1（萃取物）、ISO 8871-4（生物相容性）
blocks.en: Understand the chemical and biological requirements: ISO 8871-1 (extractables) and ISO 8871-4 (biological requirements)

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 13926-3 如何與 ISO 13926-1（玻璃筒）、ISO 13926-2（活塞塞）及 ISO 23908（筆型針頭）共同構成完整系統
blocks.en: Understand how ISO 13926-3 works together with ISO 13926-1 (glass cylinders), ISO 13926-2 (plunger stoppers) and ISO 23908 (pen needles) to form a complete system

blocks.zh: 掌握 CDMO/QC 環節針對 seal 的關鍵測試項目與驗收標準
blocks.en: Master the key seal tests and acceptance criteria at the CDMO/QC level

blocks.zh: Foreword & Introduction — 前言與導論
blocks.en: Foreword & Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 解析與應用 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 76 的重要性
blocks.en: The Role of ISO/TC 76

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 76 負責輸液、注射與採血設備的國際標準，是藥用容器封裝標準的核心技術委員會。ISO 13926 系列（玻璃筒 + 活塞塞 + 密封件）全部由此委員會制定，確保系統相容性。
blocks.en: ISO/TC 76 is responsible for international standards on infusion, injection and blood-transfusion equipment, and is the core technical committee for pharmaceutical container and closure standards. The whole ISO 13926 series (glass cylinders + plunger stoppers + seals) was developed by this committee to ensure system compatibility.

blocks.zh: 第二版主要變化的意義
blocks.en: Significance of the Main Changes in the Second Edition

blocks.zh: 29G (0.34 mm OD) 針頭測試：現代筆型注射器針頭越來越細（痛感更低），第二版特別指定以 29G 針頭進行碎屑（fragmentation）測試，更貼近臨床實際使用情境。
blocks.en: Testing with a 29G (0.34 mm OD) needle: Pen-injector needles are getting ever finer (for less pain), so the second edition specifies a 29G needle for the fragmentation test, which is closer to actual clinical use.

blocks.zh: 鋁帽表面處理：新增陽極氧化（anodized）或適當塗層要求，防止鋁帽腐蝕影響密封完整性。
blocks.en: Surface treatment of the aluminium cap: A requirement for anodizing or a suitable coating has been added to prevent corrosion of the aluminium cap from compromising seal integrity.

blocks.zh: cGMP 適用於彈性體包材
blocks.en: cGMP Applies to Elastomeric Components

blocks.zh: seal 不只是「零件」，它是直接接觸藥液的初級包裝元件。ISO 15378 的 cGMP 原則同樣適用於其製造過程，包括：配方批次記錄、原材料放行、製程監控、成品測試。CDMO 在評估供應商時，應要求 seal 製造商提供 ISO 15378 合規聲明。
blocks.en: A seal is not just a "part"; it is a primary packaging component in direct contact with the drug product. The cGMP principles of ISO 15378 apply equally to its manufacture, including compounding batch records, raw material release, process monitoring and finished-product testing. When assessing suppliers, a CDMO should require the seal manufacturer to provide an ISO 15378 compliance declaration.

blocks.zh: Clause 1 — Scope 範圍
blocks.en: Clause 1 — Scope

blocks.zh: Seal（密封件）的雙重功能
blocks.en: The Dual Function of the Seal

blocks.zh: 筆型注射器的 seal 同時承擔兩項關鍵任務：
blocks.en: The seal of a pen-injector performs two key tasks at the same time:

blocks.zh: 屏障功能：在注射前與注射間隙，阻止藥液洩漏，維持無菌屏障
blocks.en: Barrier function: Prevents leakage of the drug solution before and between injections, and maintains the sterile barrier

blocks.zh: 穿刺-重密封功能：允許針頭穿刺進入取藥，針頭退出後橡膠彈性使孔道自動閉合（resealability）
blocks.en: Penetration and resealing function: Allows the needle to penetrate to access the drug; after the needle is withdrawn, the elasticity of the rubber closes the channel automatically (resealability)

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：自我修復的橡皮擦
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: A Self-Healing Eraser

blocks.zh: 想像 seal 像一塊有記憶的橡皮擦：針頭刺入時留下通道讓藥液流出，針頭拔出後橡膠立即回彈「填補」孔道。患者每次注射都要刺穿同一個 seal（多劑量筆），因此 seal 必須能承受反覆穿刺而不失效。
blocks.en: Imagine the seal as an eraser with a memory: when the needle goes in it leaves a channel for the drug to flow out, and when the needle is withdrawn the rubber springs back immediately and "fills in" the channel. With a multi-dose pen the patient pierces the same seal at every injection, so the seal must withstand repeated penetration without failing.

blocks.zh: NOTE 的法規意涵
blocks.en: Regulatory Implications of the NOTE

blocks.zh: 這條 NOTE 直接呼應 ICH Q1A 穩定性指引：初級包材（包括 seal）的物理化學性質影響藥品效力（potency）、純度（purity）和安全性（safety）。在 NDA/MAA 申請中，seal 的材料認證和測試數據屬於 3.2.P.7（包裝/容器密封系統）必要文件。
blocks.en: This NOTE directly echoes the ICH Q1A stability guideline: the physicochemical properties of primary packaging materials (including the seal) affect the potency, purity and safety of the drug product. In an NDA/MAA, the seal's material certification and test data are required documentation under 3.2.P.7 (Container Closure System).

blocks.zh: Clause 2 — Normative References 規範性引用文件
blocks.en: Clause 2 — Normative References

blocks.zh: ISO 13926 系列：完整筆型容器密封系統
blocks.en: The ISO 13926 Series: The Complete Pen Container Closure System

blocks.zh: ISO 13926 三個部分共同定義完整的筆型注射器容器密封系統：
blocks.en: The three parts of ISO 13926 together define the complete container closure system of a pen-injector:

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1（玻璃筒）：筒體尺寸、玻璃材質、矽化處理
blocks.en: ISO 13926-1 (glass cylinders): barrel dimensions, glass material, siliconization

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-2（活塞塞/plunger stopper）：後端推進用橡膠塞，由驅動機構推送藥液
blocks.en: ISO 13926-2 (plunger stoppers): the rubber stopper at the rear end that is advanced by the drive mechanism to expel the drug solution

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-3（密封件/seal）：前端針頭穿刺的橡膠隔膜，本文件
blocks.en: ISO 13926-3 (seals): the rubber septum at the front end that is penetrated by the needle; this document

blocks.zh: 三者尺寸必須相互配合，才能確保藥液不洩漏且操作順暢。
blocks.en: The dimensions of the three components must match one another to ensure there is no drug leakage and that operation is smooth.

blocks.zh: ISO 8871 系列對 CDMO 的重要性
blocks.en: Why the ISO 8871 Series Matters to CDMOs

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1（萃取物）：橡膠與滅菌水接觸後的萃取物測試——直接關係到蛋白質藥物相容性，萃取物可能導致蛋白質聚集或降解
blocks.en: ISO 8871-1 (extractables): testing of the extractables obtained when rubber is in contact with sterile water; directly related to compatibility with protein drugs, since extractables can cause protein aggregation or degradation

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-4（生物要求）：細胞毒性、致敏性等生物安全測試
blocks.en: ISO 8871-4 (biological requirements): biological safety tests such as cytotoxicity and sensitization

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-5（功能要求）：碎屑（fragmentation）測試方法的引用標準
blocks.en: ISO 8871-5 (functional requirements): the referenced standard for the fragmentation test method

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3 與 ISO 13926-3 的分工
blocks.en: Division of Roles between ISO 11608-3 and ISO 13926-3

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3（完成品容器）定義系統層面的 resealability 要求；ISO 13926-3 在元件層面要求 seal 必須符合 ISO 11608-3 的規定。兩者是「系統標準」與「元件標準」的上下層關係。
blocks.en: ISO 11608-3 (finished containers) defines the system-level resealability requirement; ISO 13926-3 requires, at the component level, that the seal comply with ISO 11608-3. The two are in a hierarchical relationship, as the "system standard" and the "component standard".

blocks.zh: Clause 4 — Classification 分類
blocks.en: Clause 4 — Classification

blocks.zh: Type A: Seals with a mono-layer disc — 單層橡膠圓片
blocks.en: Type A: Seals with a mono-layer disc

blocks.zh: Type B: Seals with a double-layer disc — 雙層橡膠圓片
blocks.en: Type B: Seals with a double-layer disc

blocks.zh: Type A vs. Type B：選型考量
blocks.en: Type A vs. Type B: Selection Considerations

blocks.zh: Type A（單層）：結構簡單，成本較低，適合穿刺力要求較寬鬆的應用。
blocks.en: Type A (single layer): Simple construction and lower cost; suitable for applications with less demanding penetration-force requirements.

blocks.zh: Type B（雙層）：兩層不同配方橡膠複合——通常外層（藥液接觸側）選用相容性更好、萃取物更低的彈性體（如卤化丁基橡膠），內層（鋁帽貼合側）選用密封性更佳的材料。雙層設計可同時優化藥液相容性和密封完整性。
blocks.en: Type B (double layer): Two layers of rubber with different formulations are combined. Typically the outer layer (drug-contact side) uses an elastomer with better compatibility and lower extractables (such as halobutyl rubber), while the inner layer (the side against the aluminium cap) uses a material with better sealing performance. The double-layer design optimizes both drug compatibility and seal integrity.

blocks.zh: 尺寸公差的臨床意義
blocks.en: Clinical Significance of Dimensional Tolerances

blocks.zh: 圓孔（bore）直徑 d₂ = 3.0 ± 0.2 mm，這是針頭導引孔——直徑過大會降低密封力，過小則增加首次穿刺力。
blocks.en: The bore diameter d₂ = 3.0 ± 0.2 mm is the needle guide hole: if the diameter is too large the sealing force is reduced, and if it is too small the initial penetration force increases.

blocks.zh: 碟片厚度 h₂ 直接影響：穿刺力（越厚越難刺穿）、自密封性（越厚橡膠回彈力越強）、碎屑風險（越厚可能在針頭切割時產生更多橡膠碎片）。
blocks.en: The disc thickness h₂ directly affects penetration force (the thicker, the harder to pierce), resealability (the thicker, the stronger the rubber's recovery) and fragmentation risk (the thicker, the more rubber fragments may be produced when the needle cuts through).

blocks.zh: Press-fit 的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Press-Fit

blocks.zh: 橡膠圓片必須緊壓嵌入鋁帽（press-fit）。若嵌合力不足，運輸振動或高壓滅菌後圓片可能鬆脫或移位，導致洩漏和無菌失效。QC 入料檢驗時，拉脫力（pull-out force）是重要的確認項目。
blocks.en: The rubber disc must be pressed firmly into the aluminium cap (press-fit). If the fitting force is insufficient, vibration in transport or autoclaving may loosen or displace the disc, leading to leakage and loss of sterility. At QC incoming inspection, the pull-out force is an important item to confirm.

blocks.zh: 指定命名的實際用途
blocks.en: Practical Use of the Designation

blocks.zh: 標準命名格式在採購規格書（Purchase Specification）和 DMF（Drug Master File）中直接使用。例如在與墨水芯（cartridge）供應商的技術協議中，明確寫入「Seal ISO 13926-3 – 7,5 – B」即可確定所有尺寸和類型要求，無需重複描述。
blocks.en: The standard designation format is used directly in purchase specifications and in the DMF (Drug Master File). For example, in a technical agreement with a cartridge supplier, simply writing "Seal ISO 13926-3 – 7,5 – B" fixes all dimensional and type requirements without having to describe them again.

blocks.zh: Clause 7 — Material 材料
blocks.en: Clause 7 — Material

blocks.zh: 7.1 Cap（鋁帽）
blocks.en: 7.1 Cap (aluminium cap)

blocks.zh: 7.2 Disc（橡膠圓片）
blocks.en: 7.2 Disc (rubber disc)

blocks.zh: 鋁帽表面處理的必要性
blocks.en: Why Surface Treatment of the Aluminium Cap Is Necessary

blocks.zh: 陽極氧化（anodizing）在鋁帽表面形成氧化鋁層，防止鋁離子溶出污染藥液，同時增強耐腐蝕性（尤其對鹼性或酸性蛋白質製劑）。Lacquer 塗層則增加表面潤滑性，有助於自動裝配線上的高速定位。
blocks.en: Anodizing forms an aluminium oxide layer on the cap surface, which prevents aluminium ions from leaching out and contaminating the drug solution and also improves corrosion resistance (especially for alkaline or acidic protein formulations). A lacquer coating increases surface lubricity, which helps with high-speed positioning on automated assembly lines.

blocks.zh: 「End User Approved」橡膠配方
blocks.en: "End User Approved" Rubber Formulations

blocks.zh: 這是藥品包材管理的核心原則：橡膠配方一旦經藥廠（end user）驗證並在 NDA/MAA 中申報，供應商不得單方面更改。任何配方變更都需要通知藥廠，並可能觸發藥品申報的 CBE（Changes Being Effected）或 Prior Approval 補充申請。
blocks.en: This is a core principle of pharmaceutical packaging material management: once a rubber formulation has been validated by the pharmaceutical company (end user) and filed in the NDA/MAA, the supplier may not change it unilaterally. Any formulation change requires notification of the pharmaceutical company and may trigger a CBE (Changes Being Effected) or Prior Approval supplement to the drug application.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在採購 seal 時，必須確認所用配方與藥廠申報配方一致，並保存 CoC（Certificate of Conformance）。
blocks.en: When purchasing seals, the CDMO must confirm that the formulation used is consistent with the formulation filed by the pharmaceutical company, and must retain the CoC (Certificate of Conformance).

blocks.zh: 滅菌耐受性要求解析
blocks.en: Interpreting the Sterilization Resistance Requirement

blocks.zh: 要求：橡膠圓片需耐受 2 個滅菌週期（121 ± 2°C，飽和蒸汽，30 分鐘）而不損害功能。
blocks.en: Requirement: The rubber disc must withstand 2 sterilization cycles (121 ± 2°C, saturated steam, 30 minutes) without impairment of function.

blocks.zh: 背景：藥液填充後的 cartridge 需要最終滅菌（terminal sterilization）或密封後蒸汽滅菌。兩個週期的要求預留了重新滅菌（re-sterilization）的可能性，也確保了 seal 在製程中耐熱的一致性。
blocks.en: Background: A filled cartridge requires terminal sterilization, or steam sterilization after sealing. The two-cycle requirement allows for the possibility of re-sterilization and also ensures consistent heat resistance of the seal during processing.

blocks.zh: Gamma 輻照：對橡膠分子鏈有交聯和降解雙重效應，需個別評估劑量-效能關係，不能直接套用蒸汽滅菌數據。
blocks.en: Gamma irradiation: Gamma irradiation has both crosslinking and degrading effects on rubber polymer chains, so the dose-performance relationship must be assessed separately; steam sterilization data cannot simply be applied.

blocks.zh: Type Sample（型式樣品）制度
blocks.en: The Type Sample System

blocks.zh: 供應商每批交貨都要對照最初驗證通過的 type sample，這相當於工業界的「黃金標準樣品（reference standard）」制度。CDMO 應在供應商審計時確認 type sample 的保存條件和比對方法是否規範。
blocks.en: Every delivered batch from the supplier is compared against the type sample that was originally approved, which is equivalent to the "golden standard" reference standard system in industry. During supplier audits, the CDMO should confirm that the storage conditions and comparison method for the type sample are properly controlled.

blocks.zh: Clause 8 — Requirements 要求
blocks.en: Clause 8 — Requirements

blocks.zh: 硬度（Hardness）與使用體驗的關係
blocks.en: Hardness and the User Experience

blocks.zh: 橡膠硬度直接影響兩個關鍵使用參數：
blocks.en: Rubber hardness directly affects two key parameters in use:

blocks.zh: 穿刺力（Penetration Force）：硬度越高，患者刺入針頭所需力道越大。對老年患者、關節炎患者或兒童而言，過高穿刺力影響用藥依從性。
blocks.en: Penetration Force: The higher the hardness, the more force the patient needs to insert the needle. For elderly patients, arthritis patients or children, an excessive penetration force affects adherence to treatment.

blocks.zh: 自密封性（Resealability）：硬度越高，橡膠回彈力越強，密封效果越好；但硬度過高會使橡膠彈性降低，反而影響密封。
blocks.en: Resealability: The higher the hardness, the stronger the rubber's recovery and the better the seal; but if the hardness is too high the elasticity of the rubber is reduced, which in turn impairs sealing.

blocks.zh: ±5 Shore A 的公差窗口，是在兩者之間取得平衡的規範化表達。
blocks.en: The tolerance window of ±5 Shore A is the standardized expression of the balance between the two.

blocks.zh: Fragmentation（碎屑）風險 — 注射安全的核心議題
blocks.en: Fragmentation Risk: A Core Injection Safety Issue

blocks.zh: 每次針頭穿刺都會從橡膠圓片上切割出微小碎片（coring），若這些碎片進入藥液並被注射入患者體內，可能導致：
blocks.en: Every needle penetration cuts tiny fragments from the rubber disc (coring). If these fragments enter the drug solution and are injected into the patient, they may cause:

blocks.zh: 注射部位微粒引發的局部炎症反應
blocks.en: Local inflammatory reactions at the injection site triggered by particulates

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥物（如胰島素、GLP-1 類藥物）因橡膠顆粒觸發的聚集
blocks.en: Aggregation of protein drugs (such as insulin and GLP-1 drugs) triggered by rubber particles

blocks.zh: 靜脈內注射的栓塞風險（雖筆型注射器為皮下注射）
blocks.en: Risk of embolism with intravenous injection (although pen-injectors are used for subcutaneous injection)

blocks.zh: 使用 29G 超細針頭測試，代表最嚴苛的使用條件——更細的針頭切割角度更銳，更容易造成 coring。
blocks.en: Testing with an ultra-fine 29G needle represents the most severe use condition: a finer needle has a sharper cutting angle and is more likely to cause coring.

blocks.zh: Resealability（自密封性）— 多劑量筆型注射器的核心挑戰
blocks.en: Resealability: The Core Challenge for Multi-Dose Pen-Injectors

blocks.zh: 不同於單劑量裝置，筆型注射器的一支 cartridge 可能供患者使用數天至數週（例如 3 mL 胰島素筆，每天 3 次注射，連用 5-10 天），需要承受 數十次反覆穿刺。
blocks.en: Unlike single-dose devices, one cartridge in a pen-injector may be used by the patient for days to weeks (for example, a 3 mL insulin pen with 3 injections a day lasts 5-10 days), and must withstand dozens of repeated penetrations.

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3 規定的 resealability 測試模擬此情境：在指定次數穿刺後，seal 必須仍能防止洩漏並維持無菌屏障。CDMO 在產品開發階段應進行 seal 與藥液的相容性研究（container closure integrity study）。
blocks.en: The resealability test specified in ISO 11608-3 simulates this scenario: after the specified number of penetrations, the seal must still prevent leakage and maintain the sterile barrier. During product development the CDMO should carry out seal-drug compatibility studies (container closure integrity studies).

blocks.zh: E&L（Extractables & Leachables）對蛋白質藥物的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of E&L (Extractables & Leachables) for Protein Drugs

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1 的萃取物（Extractables）測試使用水性高壓蒸汽萃取，但實際洩溶物（Leachables）會在整個產品儲存期間（最長 2-3 年）持續遷移到藥液中。
blocks.en: The ISO 8871-1 extractables test uses aqueous autoclave extraction, but actual leachables continue to migrate into the drug solution throughout the product's shelf life (up to 2-3 years).

blocks.zh: 對蛋白質藥物（胰島素、GLP-1、生長激素）的特殊風險：
blocks.en: Special risks for protein drugs (insulin, GLP-1, growth hormone):

blocks.zh: 橡膠硫化助劑（vulcanization agents）可能誘導蛋白質聚集
blocks.en: Rubber vulcanization agents may induce protein aggregation

blocks.zh: 抗氧化劑（antioxidants）可能干擾效力測試
blocks.en: Antioxidants may interfere with potency testing

blocks.zh: 塑化劑（plasticizers）可能破壞蛋白質折疊構象
blocks.en: Plasticizers may disrupt the folded conformation of proteins

blocks.zh: CDMO 應要求供應商提供詳細的 E&L Profile，並進行藥液-seal 相容性模擬實驗（ICH Q2R2 相關）。
blocks.en: The CDMO should require the supplier to provide a detailed E&L profile and carry out drug-seal compatibility simulation studies (relevant to ICH Q2R2).

blocks.zh: Resistance to Ageing — 包材老化管理
blocks.en: Resistance to Ageing: Managing Packaging Material Ageing

blocks.zh: 橡膠老化（熱老化、光老化、臭氧老化）會導致：硬化（hardening）使穿刺力增加；龜裂（cracking）使密封失效；配方助劑遷移加速增加 leachables。
blocks.en: Rubber ageing (heat, light and ozone ageing) leads to: hardening, which increases penetration force; cracking, which causes seal failure; and accelerated migration of formulation additives, which increases leachables.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 QC 放行程序應包含：seal 到期日（有效期）核查，並在穩定性試驗計劃（Stability Protocol）中納入每個時間點的 container closure integrity 測試。
blocks.en: The CDMO's QC release procedure should include verification of the seal expiry date (shelf life), and the Stability Protocol should include container closure integrity testing at each time point.

blocks.zh: Annex A (Normative) — Leakage Test 洩漏測試
blocks.en: Annex A (Normative) — Leakage Test

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Leakage Test

blocks.zh: 施加的力 F = 0.64 N/mm² × d² 模擬的是筆型注射器在正常使用中產生的最大內部壓力（相當於每平方毫米 0.64 牛頓）。這個壓力值由 ISO TC 76 基於臨床使用研究確定，代表患者可能在不當操作下對 cartridge 施加的最大壓力。
blocks.en: The applied force F = 0.64 N/mm² × d² simulates the maximum internal pressure generated during normal use of a pen-injector (equivalent to 0.64 newtons per square millimetre). This pressure value was determined by ISO/TC 76 on the basis of clinical use studies and represents the maximum pressure a patient might apply to the cartridge through improper handling.

blocks.zh:
計算示例（內徑 d = 9 mm）：
F = 0.64 × 9² = 0.64 × 81 ≈ 51.8 N（約 5.3 公斤力）
blocks.en:
Worked example (inner diameter d = 9 mm):
F = 0.64 × 9² = 0.64 × 81 ≈ 51.8 N (about 5.3 kgf)

blocks.zh: 聯合測試的實際優勢
blocks.en: Practical Advantages of the Combined Test

blocks.zh: Annex A 允許同時測試 seal（前端密封）和 plunger stopper（後端活塞塞，ISO 13926-2）的洩漏性。這對 CDMO 的 QC 效率非常有利：一次組裝 10 個充水 cartridge，施壓後同時觀察兩端洩漏情況，節省約 50% 測試時間和材料。
blocks.en: Annex A allows the leakage of both the seal (front-end closure) and the plunger stopper (rear-end stopper, ISO 13926-2) to be tested at the same time. This is very beneficial for CDMO QC efficiency: assemble 10 water-filled cartridges at once, apply pressure, and observe leakage at both ends simultaneously, saving about 50% of test time and materials.

blocks.zh: 空氣自由（Air-free）的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Air-Free Filling

blocks.zh: 充填去氣水（air-free water）模擬藥液填充狀態。若水中含有氣泡，在施壓時氣體會先壓縮然後膨脹，造成「假陽性洩漏」——看似洩漏實際上是氣泡移動。有色溶液（如亞甲藍）可提高微量洩漏的目視檢測靈敏度，適用於生產線 GMP 驗證。
blocks.en: Filling with air-free water simulates the filled state of the drug solution. If the water contains air bubbles, the gas will first compress and then expand under pressure, causing "false positive leakage", which looks like leakage but is actually bubble movement. A coloured solution (such as methylene blue) improves the visual detection sensitivity for minute leaks and is suitable for GMP validation on the production line.

blocks.zh: CDMO QC 測試計劃建議
blocks.en: Recommended CDMO QC Test Plan

blocks.zh: 基於 ISO 13926-3 要求，CDMO 對 seal 的 QC 測試計劃應包含：
blocks.en: Based on the requirements of ISO 13926-3, the CDMO's QC test plan for seals should include:

blocks.zh: 入料檢驗（IQC）：尺寸、硬度（每批），CoC 核查
blocks.en: Incoming inspection (IQC): dimensions and hardness (every batch), CoC verification

blocks.zh: 功能驗證：洩漏測試（每批或依 AQL 抽樣），fragmentation（定期確認/首批驗證）
blocks.en: Functional verification: leakage test (every batch or AQL sampling), fragmentation (periodic confirmation / first-batch verification)

blocks.zh: 相容性研究：E&L 評估（開發階段），每年 stability 計劃中 CCI 測試
blocks.en: Compatibility studies: E&L assessment (development stage), CCI testing in the annual stability programme

blocks.zh: 供應商變更管控：配方/供應商變更時觸發全套重新確認
blocks.en: Supplier change control: a formulation or supplier change triggers full re-confirmation

blocks.zh: 系統相容性 — ISO 13926-3 在筆型注射器生態系統中的位置
blocks.en: System Compatibility: Where ISO 13926-3 Fits in the Pen-Injector Ecosystem

blocks.zh: 標準體系架構 Standards Ecosystem
blocks.en: Standards Ecosystem

blocks.zh: ISO 23908（筆型注射針）的配合使用
blocks.en: Use Together with ISO 23908 (Pen Needles)

blocks.zh: ISO 23908 定義筆型注射器用針頭的規格，包括針頭長度、外徑、針座（hub）設計。Seal 設計者必須確保：
blocks.en: ISO 23908 defines the specifications of needles for pen-injectors, including needle length, outer diameter and hub design. The seal designer must ensure:

blocks.zh: 針頭外徑（如 29G = 0.34 mm, 31G = 0.25 mm, 32G = 0.23 mm）與 seal 穿刺特性的配合
blocks.en: The needle outer diameter (e.g. 29G = 0.34 mm, 31G = 0.25 mm, 32G = 0.23 mm) is matched to the penetration characteristics of the seal

blocks.zh: 針座安裝後不影響 seal 的表面結構和密封功能
blocks.en: Mounting of the needle hub does not affect the surface structure or sealing function of the seal

blocks.zh: 在最細針頭（32G）條件下的 fragmentation 和 resealability 仍符合要求
blocks.en: Fragmentation and resealability still meet the requirements with the finest needle (32G)

blocks.zh: 系統整合商（CDMO）的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the System Integrator (CDMO)

blocks.zh: CDMO 在筆型注射藥品生產中扮演系統整合商：採購符合 ISO 13926-1 的玻璃筒、ISO 13926-2 的活塞塞、ISO 13926-3 的 seal，在無菌環境下完成灌裝和組裝。每個元件都必須符合其對應標準，且三者組合後必須通過系統層面的 ISO 11608-3 確認測試。
blocks.en: In the manufacture of pen-injector drug products, the CDMO acts as the system integrator: it procures glass cylinders conforming to ISO 13926-1, plunger stoppers conforming to ISO 13926-2 and seals conforming to ISO 13926-3, and completes filling and assembly in an aseptic environment. Each component must comply with its corresponding standard, and the three combined must pass the system-level confirmation tests of ISO 11608-3.

blocks.zh: 任何單一元件的改變（如 seal 供應商變更）都可能影響整個系統的相容性，需要重新進行系統驗證。
blocks.en: A change in any single component (such as a change of seal supplier) may affect the compatibility of the whole system and requires system re-validation.

blocks.zh: 法規申報中的文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements in Regulatory Filings

blocks.zh: 在 NDA/MAA 的 3.2.P.7（容器密封系統）章節中，申請人需要提供：
blocks.en: In section 3.2.P.7 (Container Closure System) of the NDA/MAA, the applicant needs to provide:

blocks.zh: Seal 的材料說明（彈性體配方，附 CoA）
blocks.en: Material description of the seal (elastomer formulation, with CoA)

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-3 符合性聲明（附測試報告）
blocks.en: Declaration of conformity to ISO 13926-3 (with test reports)

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-1 萃取物測試報告
blocks.en: ISO 8871-1 extractables test report

blocks.zh: ISO 8871-4 生物評估報告
blocks.en: ISO 8871-4 biological evaluation report

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity（CCI）數據
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity (CCI) data

blocks.zh: Seal 在藥品整個儲存期的穩定性數據
blocks.en: Stability data for the seal over the entire shelf life of the drug product

blocks.zh: Clause 9 — Labelling & Bibliography 標示與參考文獻
blocks.en: Clause 9 — Labelling & Bibliography

blocks.zh: 標示作為合規聲明
blocks.en: Labelling as a Declaration of Compliance

blocks.zh: 在包裝上標示「Seal ISO 13926-3 – 7,5 – A」意味著製造商聲明該批 seal 已通過本標準所有要求測試。CDMO 在入料時核查此標示是快速確認符合性的第一道關口，但不能替代 CoC 和測試報告的審核。
blocks.en: Marking the packaging "Seal ISO 13926-3 – 7,5 – A" means the manufacturer declares that the batch of seals has passed all the tests required by this standard. Checking this marking at receipt is the first gate for quickly confirming compliance, but it cannot replace review of the CoC and test reports.

blocks.zh: ISO 2230 橡膠貯存指引的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the ISO 2230 Rubber Storage Guidance

blocks.zh: 橡膠儲存條件對 seal 性能影響極大。ISO 2230 規定：避免直接光照（紫外線加速老化）、儲存溫度 <25°C、遠離臭氧源（如電機、螢光燈）、不受壓力或拉伸。CDMO 的倉庫管理程序（SOP）應明確參照 ISO 2230，並在穩定性研究中確認實際儲存條件的適用性。
blocks.en: Storage conditions have a major effect on seal performance. ISO 2230 specifies: avoid direct light (ultraviolet light accelerates ageing), storage temperature <25°C, keep away from ozone sources (such as electric motors and fluorescent lamps), and no compression or stretching. The CDMO's warehouse management procedure (SOP) should explicitly reference ISO 2230 and confirm the applicability of the actual storage conditions in stability studies.

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的核心意義
blocks.en: The Core Significance of ISO 15378

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 是 ISO 9001 在藥用初級包材製造中的特化版本，要求 seal 製造商按 GMP 原則運作——包括：批次文件、偏差管理、變更控制、客戶通知義務。CDMO 應在供應商審計清單中包含 ISO 15378 認證核查。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 is the specialized version of ISO 9001 for the manufacture of primary packaging materials for medicinal products. It requires seal manufacturers to operate according to GMP principles, including batch documentation, deviation management, change control and customer notification obligations. The CDMO should include ISO 15378 certification verification in its supplier audit checklist.

blocks.zh: 練習問題 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 自我測驗 — ISO 13926-3:2019 密封件標準（5 題）
blocks.en: Self-Test — ISO 13926-3:2019 Seals Standard (5 Questions)

blocks.zh:
ISO 13926-3 中 Type A 與 Type B seal 的主要結構差異為何？在選型時，選擇 Type B 雙層 seal 的主要驅動因素是什麼？
提示：考慮藥液相容性、密封性能與成本三者的取捨。
blocks.en:
What is the main structural difference between Type A and Type B seals in ISO 13926-3? When selecting a seal, what is the main driver for choosing a Type B double-layer seal?
Hint: consider the trade-off among drug compatibility, sealing performance and cost.

blocks.zh:
筆型注射器 seal 的「resealability（自密封性）」為何比一般注射瓶更重要？ISO 13926-3 如何處理此要求（直接規定還是引用其他標準）？
提示：思考多劑量使用場景與引用標準結構。
blocks.en:
Why is the resealability of a pen-injector seal more important than that of an ordinary injection vial? How does ISO 13926-3 deal with this requirement (specify it directly or refer to another standard)?
Hint: think about the multi-dose use scenario and the structure of referenced standards.

blocks.zh:
ISO 13926-3 中規定 fragmentation 測試使用 29G（0.34 mm OD）針頭，而非更粗的針頭。請說明這個選擇的臨床與技術理由。如果未來市場主流轉向 32G 超細針，此測試規範是否應更新？
提示：考慮測試的最嚴苛條件代表性和標準修訂邏輯。
blocks.en:
ISO 13926-3 specifies a 29G (0.34 mm OD) needle for the fragmentation test, rather than a thicker needle. Explain the clinical and technical reasons for this choice. If the mainstream market shifts to ultra-fine 32G needles in the future, should this test specification be updated?
Hint: consider the representativeness of the most severe test condition and the logic of standard revision.

blocks.zh:
一家 CDMO 計畫使用新供應商提供的 seal（同樣聲稱符合 ISO 13926-3 和 Type B 規格），以降低採購成本。請列出 CDMO 在引入此新供應商前，必須完成的至少 5 項技術/法規確認項目。
提示：涵蓋尺寸確認、材料確認、功能測試、法規申報、E&L 評估。
blocks.en:
A CDMO plans to use seals from a new supplier (also claiming conformity to ISO 13926-3 and Type B specifications) to reduce procurement costs. List at least 5 technical/regulatory confirmation items the CDMO must complete before introducing this new supplier.
Hint: cover dimensional confirmation, material confirmation, functional testing, regulatory filing and E&L assessment.

blocks.zh:
Annex A 的洩漏測試使用公式 F = 0.64 N/mm² × d²。若一支 cartridge 的玻璃筒內徑為 9.5 mm，計算應施加的力為何？並說明此測試值在 QC 放行判定中如何使用（零洩漏要求 vs. 可接受洩漏數量）？
提示：執行計算並回顧 Annex A.4 的結果呈現方式。
blocks.en:
The Annex A leakage test uses the formula F = 0.64 N/mm² × d². If the glass cylinder of a cartridge has an inner diameter of 9.5 mm, what force should be applied? Also explain how this test value is used in the QC release decision (zero-leakage requirement vs. acceptable number of leaking units).
Hint: carry out the calculation and review how Annex A.4 presents the results.

blocks.zh: 快速參考 — ISO 13926-3 要求摘要表
blocks.en: Quick Reference — Summary of ISO 13926-3 Requirements

blocks.zh: 要求摘要 Requirements Summary
blocks.en: Requirements Summary

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵記憶點 Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Key Takeaways for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 三標準聯動，不可分割
blocks.en: Three Standards Working Together, Inseparable

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1（玻璃筒）+ ISO 13926-2（活塞塞）+ ISO 13926-3（密封件） = 完整筆型容器密封系統。任何一個元件不符規格，整個系統即告失效。
blocks.en: ISO 13926-1 (glass cylinders) + ISO 13926-2 (plunger stoppers) + ISO 13926-3 (seals) = the complete pen-injector container closure system. If any one component fails to meet its specification, the whole system fails.

blocks.zh: Seal 是「多功能、高風險」元件
blocks.en: The Seal Is a "Multi-Function, High-Risk" Component

blocks.zh: Seal 同時承擔：無菌屏障、藥液密封、多次穿刺後重密封、化學相容性、生物安全性。這使它成為筆型注射藥品中風險最高的包材元件之一，需要最嚴格的供應商管控和 QC 驗證。
blocks.en: The seal simultaneously provides the sterile barrier, drug containment, resealing after repeated penetration, chemical compatibility and biological safety. This makes it one of the highest-risk packaging components in a pen-injector drug product and calls for the strictest supplier control and QC verification.

blocks.zh: 申報關鍵：配方鎖定
blocks.en: Key Filing Point: Formulation Lock

blocks.zh: 橡膠配方一旦申報於 NDA/MAA，供應商任何未通知的配方變更都是 GMP 重大違規。建議 CDMO 在供應協議中明確規定「Material Change Notification」條款，要求供應商在任何配方或製程變更前至少提前 12 個月通知。
blocks.en: Once a rubber formulation has been filed in the NDA/MAA, any unnotified formulation change by the supplier is a major GMP violation. CDMOs are advised to include a "Material Change Notification" clause in the supply agreement, requiring the supplier to give at least 12 months' notice before any formulation or process change.

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試快速計算
blocks.en: Quick Leakage-Test Calculation

blocks.zh: 記憶訣竅：內徑每增加 1 mm，施力約增加 10-13 N。
blocks.en: Rule of thumb: for every 1 mm increase in inner diameter, the applied force increases by about 10-13 N.
